evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and adds a new `/rest/txspendingprevout/` endpoint in src/rest.cpp.
rationale: Exposes existing gettxspendingprevout functionality over the unauthenticated REST interface. As noted in the description, this addresses a gap where 'clients relying on Bitcoin Core\'s unauthenticated REST interface cannot query which transactions spend given outputs, forcing them to use the JSON-RPC interface'.
